Requirements for `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-a-bff-oidc-fail-closed-session-auth.md`:
- Header metadata:
  - `# Feature: P2-A — BFF OIDC & Fail-Closed Session Auth`
  - `Milestone: P2 — MVP / Core Features`
  - `Milestone file: docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md`
  - `Story: P2-A`
  - `Surfaces: bff`
  - `Material: no` (the embedded BFF OIDC & Redis fail-closed session model is already established in `docs/agents-v0/architecture.md`, `docs/agents-v0/design/system/arc-record.md`, and `openapi/api-v1.yaml`; no new service, datastore, or breaking API is added beyond the approved program architecture)
- `## User story`: exact 1-sentence user story from `p2-mvp-core-features.md`.
- `## Acceptance criteria`: 7 Gherkin scenarios (`AC-1` through `AC-7`, matching `Size: 7` in `p2-mvp-core-features.md`), each with `### AC-n — <name>`, `Kind: happy | negative | edge`, `Given`, `When`, `Then` (with observable HTTP statuses, headers/cookies, stored DB/Redis state, RFC 7807 `errorCode`s):
  - `AC-1` (`Kind: happy`): Initiate enterprise Google OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE login (`GET /api/v1/auth/login`) and handle callback (`GET /api/v1/auth/callback?code=...&state=...`) by exchanging the code, validating ID token claims and JWKS signature (algorithm allowlist rejecting `none`, `iss`, `aud`, `exp`, `nbf`, trusted `kid`), upserting the `users` record (`last_login_at`), resolving active non-expired `user_role_assignments` and `permissions`, storing the server-side session in Redis (`SessionStorePort`), recording an `AUTH_LOGIN_SUCCESS` row in `audit_log_entries` (or security audit event with `Encode.forJava()`), and returning `HTTP 302` with an `HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax` session cookie and `X-Correlation-ID`.
  - `AC-2` (`Kind: happy`): Retrieve authenticated principal profile via `GET /api/v1/auth/me` using the `HttpOnly` session cookie (`FailClosedRedisSessionFilter`), returning `HTTP 200` `PrincipalSessionResponse` (`userId`, `workspaceEmail`, `displayName`, `department`, `roles`, `permissions`, `effectiveViewAsRole`, `readOnlyOverlay`, and `redirectView = "DASHBOARD"` when the user holds at least one active non-expired role or `redirectView = "ROLE_APPLY_ONBOARDING"` when the user holds zero active roles).
  - `AC-3` (`Kind: happy`): Establish a deterministic local/test session via `POST /api/v1/auth/mock-login` (`MockLoginRequest` with `additionalProperties: false`) when running under `local` or `test` profile, upserting the user and optional requested `roleCodes`, persisting the Redis session, setting the `HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax` session cookie, recording `AUTH_LOGIN_SUCCESS`, and returning `HTTP 200` `PrincipalSessionResponse`.
  - `AC-4` (`Kind: happy`): Terminate the current session via `POST /api/v1/auth/logout`, deleting the active session key in Redis and writing the session/token revocation blacklist entry (`SessionStorePort.revokeSession`), expiring the `HttpOnly` session cookie (`Max-Age=0`), recording `AUTH_LOGOUT` in `audit_log_entries`, and returning `HTTP 204 No Content`.
  - `AC-5` (`Kind: negative`): Reject unauthenticated requests, expired/unknown/revoked session cookies, invalid OIDC `state`/authorization codes, or tampered JWT claims (`alg=none`, wrong `iss`/`aud`, expired `exp`/`nbf`, unknown `kid`, or inactive user `is_active = false`) with RFC 7807 `HTTP 401 Unauthorized` (`errorCode = "AUTH_UNAUTHENTICATED"`) or `HTTP 400 Bad Request` (`errorCode = "VALIDATION_ERROR"` for missing/malformed callback/mock-login parameters), recording `AUTH_LOGIN_FAILURE` on failed login attempts without creating a Redis session.
  - `AC-6` (`Kind: negative`): Reject `POST /api/v1/auth/mock-login` outside `local` and `test` profiles (e.g., `prod` / deployed environments or when mock login is disabled) with RFC 7807 `HTTP 403 Forbidden` (`errorCode = "AUTH_FORBIDDEN"`), recording an authorization/login denial audit event and never issuing a session cookie (`security-baseline.mdc` §1, §8; Threat Model Spoofing mitigation).
  - `AC-7` (`Kind: negative`): Fail closed with RFC 7807 `HTTP 503 Service Unavailable` (`errorCode = "SESSION_STORE_UNAVAILABLE"` or upstream OIDC outage) and `X-Correlation-ID` whenever Redis `sessionStore` is unreachable, times out, or has an open circuit breaker during `FailClosedRedisSessionFilter` session/revocation validation or `/api/v1/auth/**` operations, or when the OIDC token exchange/JWKS endpoint fails (`docs/agents-v0/network.md`), never falling back to stateless/unverified access or accepting revoked sessions.
